legalName: Erasure After an Absolute Pardon, C.G.S. § 54-142a(d)

componentConditions.ct-pardon-erasure-primary-filing-1: Only on the pre-1 October 1974 branch, where a petition is required. The pardon-date answer selects the branch; this packet never selects it for the participant.
componentConditions.ct-pardon-erasure-process-guidance-2: Only on the on-or-after 1 October 1974 branch, where erasure happens without a petition.

routeSelectionNote: The composed pages carry no election control. The branch fork — petition before 1 October 1974, automatic erasure on or after — turns on the participant's own pardon date, which the memo says selects the branch and which LegalEase does not choose. Each instrument prints its condition on its own face, and neither is selected for the participant.
